evidence: Current title: Chinese translation issue for description of PowerToys Run "Visual Studio Code Workspaces" plugin (`VS Code` -> `VS 代码`, `PATH` -> `路径`)

Current report excerpt: ### Microsoft PowerToys version

0.87.1

### Utility with translation issue

PowerToys Run

### 🌐 Language affected

Chinese

### ❌ Actual phrase(s)

`打开以前在 VS Code 中打开的工作区、远程计算机 (SSH 或 Codespaces) 和容器。 VS 代码实例必须位于路径中`

![In settings](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5635e1dd-35a8-4825-9f89-2f90bb85815e)

![In run panel](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f6b91d01-d101-471a-bf64-df10ec70c9e8)

### ✔️ Expected phrase(s)

`打开以前在 VS Code 中打开的工作区、远程计算机 (SSH 或 Codespaces) 和容器。 VS Code 实例必须位于 PATH 中`

### ℹ Why is the current translation wrong

"**VS Code**" is the product name (should not be translated), but the Chinese translation incorrectly translates the "**Code**" in it to "**代码**" separately

Similarly, “**PATH**” refers to an environment variable named **PATH** that should not be translated, but the Chinese translation translates it as "**路径**"
